result:
I added the timezone column and the `Expert` field. I haven't run the migration or a type check.

- **Migration:** `migrations/003_expert_timezone.sql` runs `alter table experts add column timezone text;`. The column is nullable, so existing rows are unaffected. It stores the IANA name as plain text, with no database-level validation of the name.
- **Type:** `src/experts/types.ts` now has `timezone?: string` on `Expert`.

I didn't look at `002_export_rows.sql` or any code that reads or writes experts, so I don't know whether other code needs updating.
